facts.text: PDT, FF will hold the FF EAI Robotics "Four-Core Full-Stack AI" Ecosystem New Product Series Launch where the Company will focus on launching products of two of its four cores: the EAI Devices core and the Industry Productivity Solutions core.
We will also become the U.S. robotics company with the widest range of device forms, sizes, and models.
This gives our FF Robot World more complete device support for deployment across different industry ecosystems and use cases.
This moves FF from device deployment to complete solution delivery.
FF AI-Robotics is also participating in IMTS 2026 in Chicago this week, showcasing its Aegis series security and inspection quadruped robots and their capabilities across industrial applications.

The participation further demonstrated FF's progress in bringing EAI robotics into real-world industrial applications and served as a preview of the new EAI robotics products and industry solutions to be unveiled on September 19.
FF unveiled 9 new EAI Device configurations across five models which included its FF All-New Futurist, FF Master Mini, FX Aegis Hyper, FX Aegis Mega and FX Aegis Classic Ultra-W.
Through this flywheel, FF seeks to maximize its commercial value and advance the development of Physical AI.
Faraday Future Founder and Global CEO YT Jia Weekly Investor Upda...
With the launch of these nine new configurations, FF EAI Robot World has officially been upgraded to Version 2.0.
FF offers three product packages: a standard EAI Device, an EAI Device + Skills Package, and an EAI Device + Complete Solution.
